summary: Round 15. The cabin renders and the studio set r1-r10 were made from 63f9336. My own studio shots (/tmp/claude-0/ra15/own, clean worktree at 89fd6bb) include the moved belt stub and latch tongue. Mean pixel diff against w14: q06 3.9, q07 5.5, q08 2.8, q09 2.7, q10 1.9 (of 765). What improved: (a) The cabinets and tables are darker greige. q06 cabinet went from (170,161,148) to (151,138,119); c_27312 is (125,115,102). The q06 table went from (175,171,164) to (164,157,144); c_27312 is (157,146,132). The q07 cabinet now shows real streaks (hp4 0.052, photo 0.057). (b) In studio light the aisle doors are now near-plain cream with faint grain, which matches c_27312 (o4: door (234,232,227) against table (230,224,215)). (c) The duvet is darker: r7 is 0.45/0.52/0.85 of the white pillow, close to kn_17's 0.47/0.54/0.73. (d) The buckle now carries a lift-lever plate, and the latch tongue and webbing stub lie on the open cushion (o1). (e) The pillow moved a little toward navy (q08 R/G 0.85 -> 0.79). Four things still hold the area just below 8.5. (1) In the cabin view the door and cabinet tones are still too close: q06 door (164,162,159) against cabinet (151,138,119), a ratio of 0.92; c_27312 is 0.63. The door is too dark here, partly because of lighting. Its leaves also still show dash streaks at aisle distance (hp 0.077), probably minification aliasing. (2) The pillows are unchanged rigid cushionSecs slabs. The white pillow still reads as a seat cushion (q08, q09, o2). (3) The bundle film is invisible. The three crease glints are 6 mm wide, 1 mm proud, and mostly under the pillow, so no view shows them. (4) The O comforter outline is still a crisp cross/T with straight cut edges (r9, o3), almost identical to w14 (r9 diff 3.6 % of pixels); tpg_81 shows one loose diagonal sheet. Minor: the webbing reads teal (#2c4250 under the studio key light), where kn_17 is near-black slate. The chrome reads matte grey because the studio has no environment to reflect. The latch tongue reads as a small white label. Lighting (not scored): the pillow is still over-saturated in the cabin (q08 B/G 2.22 against kn_17 1.92), and in q10 the shells are light slate (118,125,135) against c_27315 (75-97).

issues.detail: Aisle doors not separated from the cabinets in the cabin view; door leaves still streaky at aisle distance
issues.problem: In studio light the doors read near-plain cream, but in q06 they render mid-grey at almost the cabinet's luminance, and dash streaks show on the leaves. In c_27312 the door is the brightest ash in the frame, a clearly plain cream panel.
issues.evidence: q06 door (164,162,159) against cabinet (151,138,119), a ratio of 0.92; c_27312 door (198,197,191) against cabinet (125,115,102), 0.63. The q06 zoom (595-650 x 300-560) shows dash streaks.
issues.fix: 03_tex.js (shared): PHOTO_GAIN[30] 1.0 -> 0.5 and LAYER_PARAMS[30] [3.1, 0.08, 1.0, 0.1] -> [3.1, 0.04, 0.5, 0.1], so the dashes stop aliasing when minified. 09c:25 ashDoor: c '#e4ddd0' -> '#ece7dc', r 0.44 -> 0.36, which gives the door a slight satin lift as in c_27312. Ask the lighting owner whether the AO volume darkens the aisle-side faces of the units (in q06 the door is 0.83 of the photo, while the cabinet is 1.2x).

issues.detail: Pillows still rigid bevelled slabs; the white pillow reads as a seat cushion
issues.problem: No change since w13. In kn_17 and tpg_81 the pillows are puffy, with pinched dog-ear corners and soft creases.
issues.evidence: o2, q09 zoom, q08 zoom against kn_17 (230-890 x 50-650).
issues.fix: 09c:294 roomPillow: replace the two cushionSecs lofts with one 32x24 grid over u,v in [0,1]: x = (u - 0.5) * 0.44, z = (v - 0.5) * 0.34, half-thickness T = 0.05 * (1 - |2u-1|^4) * (1 - |2v-1|^4)^0.6 + 0.004, plus 0.003 * sin(7u + 3v) on the top face. Mirror it for the back face. Keep the flange loft. The corners then pinch to ~8 mm, as in kn_17.

issues.problem: The three crease glints are too thin and sit under the pillow, so the bundle does not read as being in plastic (kn_17).
issues.evidence: r7, o1, o2, q08 and q09 show no glint.
issues.fix: 09c:286: widen the glints to gBox(0.012, 0.002, L) with L 0.14-0.24. Move them to the exposed front strip (dz toward the cushion front, z + dir * (0.10..0.13)) and add 2 more. Use { c: '#e8ebf4', r: 0.05 }. Also add a film lip: gRBox(0.47, 0.003, 0.012) along the front edge in #dfe3ec r 0.1.

issues.detail: O comforter still a crisp cross/T outline
issues.problem: The drape change hardly shows. The outline keeps straight cuts and a narrow strip toward the aisle, where tpg_81 shows one loose diagonal sheet that thins toward the footwell.
issues.evidence: o3 and r9 against tpg_81; r9 differs from w14 on 3.6 % of pixels.
issues.fix: In 09c O bounds: replace the step to the narrow aisle strip with a linear taper from the table corner (z tz0) to the foot, xr = lerp(xr_wide, xr_narrow, smooth(tz0, tz0 + 0.5, z)), and add 0.03 * sin(9 z + 1.3) to xr and xl. Raise wob for O to 1.0.
